sources.title: README.md
sources.locator: Features; Background session persistence; Remote SSH repositories; CLI; Requirements; Technical stack
sources.finding: Native macOS terminal/worktree workspace uses libghostty and zmx daemon. CLI/deeplinks control worktrees/tabs/repos. Local and beta SSH repositories support persistence; remote zmx survives dropped SSH/laptop sleep. Presence badges, scripts and GitHub PR controls are documented.

sources.title: https://supacode.sh/
sources.locator: Built different; Buy once Use forever; Licensing questions
sources.finding: Marketing explicitly names Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode CLI agents. Basic costs USD 99 for one Mac, Standard USD 129 for two Macs; Team USD 79/seat minimum three. Lifetime app license includes one year of updates, optional USD 59 renewal for Basic/Standard. Trial permits five successful local worktree creations; SSH worktree creation remains free.
